static_frames.description: Historical field name: count of distinct observed result output frames; finite temporal workflow 1.2 allows up to 300.

media_receipt.description: Workflow 1.2 staged media/decode/tracking receipt emitted by the existing Host; absent before media preflight completes. A null value is the legitimate no-owned-media receipt for a static image/render_layers input; declared Movie/sequence inputs and graph media bindings require an object receipt. Host runtime and full closure validation remain authoritative.
